name: Métropole Télévision S.A.
summary: Métropole Télévision S.A. (MTPVY) is a prominent French media conglomerate that delivers a wide array of content, products, and services across various platforms. Its operations are strategically divided into four key divisions: Television, Radio, Production and Audiovisual Rights, and a broad Diversification segment. Within its Television segment, the company manages a robust portfolio of broadcast and subscription channels. Free-to-air offerings include popular stations such as M6, W9, 6TER, and Gulli. Its premium, pay-TV selection features channels like Paris Première, Téva, sérieclub, Canal J, Tiji, M6 Music, MCM, MCM Top, and RFM TV. M6 also provides on-demand viewing services such as 6play, Gulli Max, and Gulli Replay. Furthermore, it operates an advertising agency and develops acclaimed news magazine programs like Capital, Zone Interdite, Enquête Exclusive, 66 Minutes, and Enquêtes criminelles, many of which are specifically for the W9 channel. The Radio division oversees prominent stations including RTL, RTL2, and Fun Radio. The Production and Audiovisual Rights segment is involved in distributing audiovisual film rights and both producing and co-producing cinematic works. The company also handles the production, co-production, and co-distribution of music formats, encompassing singles, albums, and compilations in both physical and digital formats. Beyond its core media activities, Métropole Télévision S.A. explores various diversified ventures. These include managing events and live shows (such as concerts, stand-up comedy, and exhibitions), engaging in general program production, digital content creation and publishing, and the exploitation of merchandising rights. Its portfolio also extends to real estate services, animated feature film production, internet content provision, print publishing, and teleshopping. Further services encompass training, wholesale trade, and property sales. Established in 1986, the company's corporate headquarters are located in Neuilly-sur-Seine, France.
